data.name: Faran
data.gender_notes: Faran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Faran derives from the Persian word 'Farang' meaning 'foreigner' or 'traveler'. In Hindu tradition, Faran is believed to bring joy and happiness. This name is suitable for those who value exploration and adventure. The name Faran carries the meaning “Joyful, Traveler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Persian tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Faran usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, traveler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies joy and travel on the spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Faran belongs to the Persian linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Traveler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faran total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
